'''''Padawan''''' is a young-adult novel by [[Kiersten White]]. It was published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] on [[July 26]], [[2022]], and it focuses on [[Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Jedi Master|master]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn]].
